en.title: Streaming conversations are moving from speed alone to trustworthy operations
en.summary: Industry discussions around streaming continue to focus on governance, reliability, and operational readiness instead of only throughput and latency.
en.whyItMatters: This matters because executives do not buy streaming for speed alone. They invest when faster movement of operational data improves visibility, responsiveness, and confidence in downstream decisions.

pt.title: As conversas sobre streaming estao saindo de velocidade pura para operacao confiavel
pt.summary: As discussoes do setor sobre streaming seguem enfatizando governanca, confiabilidade e prontidao operacional, e nao apenas throughput e latencia.
pt.whyItMatters: Isso importa porque executivos nao compram streaming apenas por velocidade. O investimento acontece quando o movimento mais rapido de dados operacionais melhora visibilidade, capacidade de resposta e confianca nas decisoes downstream.
